hooks.command:
# Auto-format JS/TS files with Prettier
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" in
  *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx)
    npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>&1
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
      echo '{"feedback": "Formatting failed. Check file for syntax errors."}' >&2
      exit 1
    else
      echo '{"feedback": "Formatting applied.", "suppressOutput": true}'
    fi
    ;;
esac

# Auto-run tests when test files change
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" in
  *.test.js|*.test.jsx|*.test.ts|*.test.tsx)
    echo '{"feedback": "Running tests..."}' >&2
    npm test -- --findRelatedTests "${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH}" --passWithNoTests > /tmp/_claude_test_out.txt 2>&1
    exit_code=$?
    tail -30 /tmp/_claude_test_out.txt
    rm -f /tmp/_claude_test_out.txt
    if [ $exit_code -eq 0 ]; then
      echo '{"feedback": "Tests passed."}'
    else
      echo '{"feedback": "Tests failed. See output above."}' >&2
    fi
    ;;
esac

# Type-check TypeScript files
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" in
  *.ts|*.tsx)
    echo '{"feedback": "Checking TypeScript types..."}' >&2
    output=$(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1)
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
      echo '{"feedback": "No TypeScript errors.", "suppressOutput": true}'
    else
      errors=$(printf '%s' "$output" | grep -A 2 "error TS" | head -30)
      if [ -n "$errors" ]; then
        echo '{"feedback": "TypeScript found type errors:"}' >&2
        printf '%s\n' "$errors" >&2
      fi
    fi
    exit 0
    ;;
esac

# Update task list from TASK.md
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *TASK.md ]]; then
  echo '{"feedback": "Updating task list..."}' >&2
  # Custom script to parse TASK.md and update status (placeholder)
  # e.g., python .claude/hooks/update_tasks.py "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
  echo '{"feedback": "Task list updated.", "suppressOutput": true}'
fi
